chapter: Sightseeing With Friends: A Trip to Fontaine
act_title: Sightseeing With Friends: A Trip to Fontaine

quests.title: Sightseeing With Friends: A Trip to Fontaine

dialogue.t: Fontaine's photography pros have raved about this place like, a million times! They say it's one of the best photo spots to appreciate the nation's tidy and balanced layout!

dialogue.sit: Hmm... It's true that we rarely see it from this angle...
Yeah... It really does have a different kind of feel.

dialogue.t: Oh! Our Fungi friends are totally entranced... Guess Haniyyah didn't get to bring them here last time.
Well then, let's get started. Those popular landscape paintings from earlier should help spark some ideas for our Fungi friends!

quests.description: After wrapping up your trip through Natlan, you and your Fungi friends are off to the next destination on Paimon’s list…
